name: backup_list
description: List browser-local project backups, their stable identities, save times, sizes and optional thumbnail artifacts. Backups update every 30 seconds only when changed.

name: backup_restore
description: Restore a browser backup with complete model history, continuing its existing backup identity. Requires explicit project replacement.

name: backup_delete
description: Delete a project backup and its legacy previous snapshot. The open model is unchanged; deleting its backup pauses automatic backups for the page session.

description: Change name/display/protection properties using shared project validation.

Point clouds support pointCloudEdit deletion, extraction, point-count or voxel simplification, smoothing and radius-connected selection.

strength.description: Selected-area smoothing defaults to 0.5; boundary smoothing defaults to 0.3.

iterations.description: Selected-area smoothing defaults to 6 passes; boundary smoothing defaults to 3. Explicit values override these defaults.

neighborRadius.description: Point neighborhood radius in mm; default 0.5.

deviation.description: Maximum cumulative displacement from original sample, mm; default 0.05.

workerCount.description: Logical native lanes. Preserve this value when comparing serial and parallel output.

parallel.description: Use a bounded two-worker CPU pool when admitted; false evaluates the same logical lanes serially.

targetIds.description: Ordered fixed indexed mesh targets for nativeRefine only; mutually exclusive with targetId. Distance ties retain the first target.

name: analysis_measure

name: surface_shell
description: Inspect compatible patch seam/topology diagnostics or generate a box patch shell. Returns an artifact suitable for closedShell CAD recipe.

name: screenshot_capture
description: Capture current application or viewport as a native MCP image and downloadable artifact. Includes current WebGL pixels; password/token inputs redacted. Local DOM rendering excludes OS/browser chrome. Bounded 2048px,1MiB,10s; reduce dimensions or use JPEG on limit.

name: application_inspect
description: Inspect current visible dialogs, bounded accessible controls, statuses/errors, GUI preview/progress, active panel and workspace. Credential/file-input values omitted. Use semantic tools instead of clicking.

name: ui_set
description: Set ribbon tab, tool workspace, interaction mode and panel/settings visibility or dismiss displayed error. Changing workspace rejects active GUI previews; does not accept/cancel them.

name: viewport_get
description: Read camera projection/position/target/up/zoom, visible scene bounds and CSS viewport dimensions. No model geometry transfer.

name: viewport_control
description: Frame all/object/active selection; set projection; rotate by degrees; orient to active sketch; or set an absolute world-mm camera pose. Uses editor camera controls and leaves model/history unchanged.

name: viewport_pick
description: Inspect visible rendered mesh or point-cloud geometry at normalized top-left viewport x/y. Return ordered object IDs, world-mm points, distances, tessellation triangle indices or pointIndex. Read-only; native CAD edge/face IDs are separate.

name: history_get
description: Read retained modeling history labels and current cursor, including redo entries. Indices match history_seek; inspect fresh project revision before seeking.

name: project_update
description: Rename current project without replacing objects, authoring, history or backup identity.

name: session_get
description: Recover active/retained job IDs, progress/errors and transient artifact metadata/expiry without transferring results or file contents. GUI operations may be busy without an API job.

name: tools_search
description: Find compact tools by query terms in names, descriptions, supported parameters and nested subcommands (e.g. fillet, reducePolygons). Return optional exact schemas. Prefer this over repeating the full catalog. Empty query lists a bounded subset.

name: preview_discard
description: Explicitly discard one GUI scan/surface/landmark/sketch-section preview using the same Cancel handlers as the editor. Available while GUI workers are busy. Preserve committed model; never accepts a preview. Cancel API jobs separately with job_cancel.

name: alignment_references
description: Read exact CAD face or fitted primitive alignment references without changing geometry or history. Returns paged points, directions and display triangle ranges in mm. Unsupported surfaces are explicit. This read-only native job uses job_get/job_cancel; use fresh results after any model edit.

centerAt.description: Optional world-space point projected onto planar references
